title: The Midnight Queen
author: May Agnes Fleming
description: "The Midnight Queen" by May Agnes Fleming is a historical novel set during the late 17th century.
longDescription: The story unfolds in the plague-stricken city of London, where Death reigns amidst chaos and debauchery.
